Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 33.626944, -87.061389 (Explicit)
Reported Spill Volume: 400 gallons
Report Description
PRIVATE INDIVIDUAL HAD FLOWN INTO NORTHEAST ALABAMA REGIONAL AIRPORT FOR MAINTENANCE AT A LOCAL FACILITY ON A PRIVATELY OWNED PRE-MILITARY JET FIGHTER. INDIVIDUAL FUELED (400 GALLONS) OF JET FUEL PRIOR TO DEPARTING. UPON DEPARTING OFF RUNWAY 6 AIRCRAFT MADE A SLIGHT TURN TO SOUTH AND IMPACTED THE GROUND APPX 1/2 MILE FROM RUNWAY. PILOT DID NOT EJECT AND WAS KILLED IN CRASH. ETOWAH COUNTY EMA - ETOWAH COUNTY SHERIFF - RAINBOW CITY PD AND FD RESPONDED. THERE WAS A FIRE AND MOST OF THE FUEL WAS CONSUMED. INCIDENT OCCURRED NEXT TO DRY CREEK AND MINIMAL FUEL ENTERED CREEK. FD BOOMED THE CREEK TO CONTAIN FUEL. THIS IS A VERY LOW LYING AREA (SWAMPY) AND EXTRACTION WILL BE DIFFICULT. FAA AND NTSB ON SCENE 1/21/2012.

SkyTruth Analysis

Reported Spill Volume: 100 gallons
Report Description
A THREE VEHICLE ACCIDENT INVOLVING A SCHOOL BUS RESULTED IN THE SCHOOL BUS OVERTURNING A SPILLING 100 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL. THE FUEL ENTERED A DRAIN THAT LEADS TO A TRIBUTARY OF THE DES PLAINS RIVER. THERE WAS ONE FATALITY AND 38 PEOPLE TAKEN TO A HOSPITAL FROM THIS INCIDENT. THE REPORTING PARTY IS NOT AN INVESTIGATING OFFICER FOR THIS INCIDENT. THE FRONT END OF THE BUS HAD THE HEAVIEST DAMAGE AND THEN THE BUS ROLLED OVER TO THE SIDE. APPROXIMATELY 0900 HRS 06-02-2006 A TANKER TRUCK FROM COSTAL TRANPORT OVER TURNED ON PUEBLO OF LAGUNA LANDS OFF STATE ROAD 6 AT BM 5161. THE PUEBLO WAS NOT CONTACTED BY THE PRP OR CLEAN UP CONTRACTOR UNTIL 06-05-06, WHEN THE CLEAN UP CONTRACTOR CONTACTED THE PUEBLO TO OBTAIN PERMISSION TO START CLEAN UP AND EXCAVATION OF CONTAMINATED SOIL. IT WAS FIRST REPORTED TO THE PUEBLO CHIEF OF POLICE AND ENVIRONMENTAL DIRECTOR THAT 150-200 GALLONS OF PETROLEUM PRODUCT HAD BEEN SPILLED AT THE ACCIENT SITE. AS OF 06-06-06 COSTAL TRANSPORT IS REPORTING TO THE PUEBLO THAT 100 GALLONS MORE PRODUCT HAS BEEN RECOVERED FROM THE ACCIDENT SITE THAN WAS ORIGINALY REPORTED. THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF SPILLED PRODUCT IS UNKNOWN STILL.
